name: Battle for Bretagard
oracle_text:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Create a 1/1 white Human Warrior creature token.
II — Create a 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature token.
III — Choose any number of artifact tokens and/or creature tokens you control with different names. For each of them, create a token that's a copy of it.
blocked_sentences: III — Choose any number of artifact tokens and/or creature tokens you control with different names. For each of them, create a token that's a copy of it.

needs.what: a battlefield selector constraint for a chosen set of permanents that each have different names (choose any number of artifact or creature tokens you control, no two sharing a name), usable as the objects of copy_permanent so that one token copy is created for each chosen permanent
needs.why_existing_wont_do: distinct_names exists but the loader accepts it only on search_library and search_zones (it narrows a library/zone search after each pick); copy_permanent's options (amount, as, objects, ...) and the selector keys (any_types, is_token, controller, optional, count, shares_a_name_with, not_name) have no way to force the chosen battlefield objects to have pairwise different names, so writing copy_permanent over all artifact/creature tokens would copy two same-named tokens, which the card forbids
